description: Story 21.5 — « WhatsApp Business » (module whatsapp-cloud): the company connects its own WhatsApp Business number (Meta embedded signup), reads and answers its WhatsApp conversations, manages its message templates (Meta review), and its invoices / quotes sent by WhatsApp leave from its own number with the approved template bref_facture (PDF attached), the platform WhatsApp text with the link being the fallback. Plans: BUSINESS, BUSINESS_TRIAL, PREMIUM, PREMIUM_TRIAL (owner-disabled for companies that existed before it: « Mes modules »). Module refused → 403 MODULE_NOT_ENTITLED / MODULE_DISABLED_BY_OWNER. Owner only except GET /account (every member). Responses use Keevo's envelope: success {data, …}; error {error: French message to show, code: HTTP name, domainCode, details?}. Shapes of conversations, messages and templates are Bref's (bref/features/whatsapp-inbox, whatsapp-marketing). Ids are API handles, never shown; show statusLabel, never status. Change this file only with both sides. Story 21.6: campaigns to consenting clients, header media for media templates, STOP / START answers (client opt-out). Story 21.11: purchase-behaviour targeting of campaigns (inactiveForDays, purchasedWithinDays, totalSpentMin/Max, totalInvoicesMin/Max; purchaseCriteriaLabels to show).

endpoints.notes: Clients with the team's marketing consent, no STOP, not archived, one per phone number. overLimit = more than 5 000. 21.11: optional purchase criteria (Bref targetingCriteria) — purchases = completed POS sales + issued / paid invoices (a sale invoiced automatically counted once), credit notes deducted from the total, quotes / drafts / cancelled never count; aggregated per phone number over all its client records; with storeIds, only the purchases made in those stores. No criterion = the 21.6 count. Days are 24-hour periods back from the moment of the count (preview, save, and the send itself — a scheduled campaign is evaluated when it leaves). A credit note lowers the total but is not a purchase.

invoiceSending: POST /api/v1/invoices/{id}/send (channel WHATSAPP) is unchanged for the app: when the company number is connected and bref_facture is approved, the client receives the PDF from the company number; otherwise the platform text with the link.
stopStart: 21.6 — a client who writes STOP / ARRÊT / ARRÊTER / DÉSABONNER / UNSUBSCRIBE to the company number is opted out (marketingOptOutAt on every client of the company with that number, team consent untouched, devices pull it); START / REPRENDRE / SUBSCRIBE clears it. A confirmation is sent back at most once per minute.
quota: 21.6 — usage metric WHATSAPP_MESSAGES « Messages WhatsApp » (GET /api/v1/subscription usage): counted per message Meta accepted; no limit unless the offer sets one.
campaignNotes: 21.6 — a scheduled campaign that cannot leave when due (template deleted / no longer approved, nobody, too many) goes back to « Brouillon »; a header media id expires after 30 days at Meta (scheduling further out with a media id is refused, use a link); START from a number that was not opted out gets no confirmation.
